Protein supports tissue maintenance and repair. Examples: beans, lentils, eggs, fish and poultry. Portions and recipes change the values.
Fat provides energy and helps absorb fat-soluble vitamins. Examples: nuts, seeds, olive oil and fish. Small portions can contain substantial energy.
Carbohydrates are an energy source. Examples: whole grains, potatoes, fruit and legumes. Foods also differ in fibre and added sugar.
Calories measure food energy. Photo estimates can miss ingredients and portion size. Review the draft; a daily target is an estimate, not a diagnosis.
